method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: One panorama about 7.7 m from the fronts, resected on both corners of the cottage; its base row lies at 0 with a camera 2.3 m high. A second heading along the block puts its east end within 0.5 m of the district outline. The block's far windows are read at a grazing angle (about ±0.3 m). Roofs and the yards are estimates.
